founded.heading: Founded in 1989, a story of passion and evolution
founded.paragraph: Born under the name Tunisie Photo in 1989 thanks to the vision of Nabile Ben Younes, our company has evolved over time. In 2006, it became Omega Distribution, establishing its position as an essential wholesaler and supplier for photography professionals in Tunisia. Over three decades of expertise, commitment and innovation.

presence.heading: Commercial Presence Across the Entire Territory
presence.paragraph1: At Omega Distribution, we ensure nationwide coverage through a structured network of sales agents. Each sector is managed by a dedicated representative who visits our clients weekly or biweekly, depending on the location.
presence.paragraph2: In the most remote regions, we rely on trusted logistics partners to guarantee regular and reliable deliveries.
presence.paragraph3: This organization allows us to stay close to our clients, wherever they are, and to offer them responsive and personalized service.

clients.heading: 550+ Professional Clients Trust Us
clients.paragraph: Since our humble beginnings in 1989, we have built our reputation on the quality of our products and the reliability of our service. Thanks to a solid logistics network, a constant presence in the field, and a commitment to our clients, we have earned the trust of over 550 professional photographers, labs and hardware stores across all of Tunisia. Progressive growth that reflects our seriousness and our passion for imaging.
